# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-4728

# Review — PAN-4728
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — CI `lint-group (core)` is red: `pan skills pack add` changed but `packages/contracts/src/composer-commands.generated.ts` was not regenerated

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-4728-review-5b382b05
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4728/.pan/review/agent-pan-4728-review-5b382b05/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-4728 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4728
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/4737 (head 5b382b05 matches)
- HEAD reviewed: 5b382b053cdf3e84e4751613cbc448bdaffe1c67
- Base / prior cycle SHA: efee700bbcd (merge-base with origin/main); no prior review cycle

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness] Composer-command manifest not regenerated after the `pack add` CLI change — `src/cli/commands/skills.ts:508`
- Severity: ! (MUST)
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect; in_pr_scope (AC-9 "`npm run lint` passes")
- Trigger and changed-code connection: the PR changes `pack.command('add <id> <url>')` to `add <id> [url]`, the description, and `--ref` from `requiredOption` to `option` (`src/cli/commands/skills.ts:508-512`). `scripts/lint-slash-commands.sh` compares the CLI registry against the committed `packages/contracts/src/composer-commands.generated.ts`, which this branch does not touch.
- Expected / observed / impact: expected the generated manifest to carry the new `pan-skills-pack-add` entry. Observed on CI run 41339606595, job `lint-group (core)` (https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/actions/runs/41339606595/job/124946611853): the diff shows the old entry (`url` required, old description, old `--ref` text) vs. the new one, then `composer-command manifest has drifted from the CLI registry — run 'npm run generate:slash-commands' and commit the result`, exit 1. The required CI check is red, so the PR cannot merge, and until it is fixed the dashboard composer would keep advertising `url` as required.
- Evidence: CI job log (step "Lint (core)", `npm run lint:slash-commands`). `git diff efee700 HEAD --stat` lists no change to `packages/contracts/src/composer-commands.generated.ts`.
- Fix: the generator reads the CLI registry from the built `dist/cli/index.js` (`scripts/lint-slash-commands.sh`), so rebuild first: `npm run build:contracts && npm run build:cli`, then `npm run generate:slash-commands`, then commit `packages/contracts/src/composer-commands.generated.ts`. Regenerating against a stale dist leaves CI red for the same reason. This does not conflict with non-goal 5 ("No dashboard changes"): the manifest is a required generated artifact of the CLI change, not a dashboard behavior change, and the dashboard's mattpocock add-command hint stays as-is.

## Non-blocking Findings
- `?` `extractCommit` (`src/lib/skill-packs/sources.ts:240-243`) removes a root-less cached extraction and rebuilds it. If another process is reading that extraction at the same moment (for example, a launch building a mount), the read can fail. This happens only once, when a cache made by older code lacks the plugin root, and pstack had no older extractions. This is a hypothesis with no demonstrated trigger.
- `?` `assertMountPack` (`src/lib/skill-packs/mount.ts:94-105`) validates `extras` but not `pluginRoot`. Both values come only from the `KNOWN_PACKS` constant (a non-goal forbids a CLI/registry field), so nothing attacker-controlled reaches them. This is optional hardening.
- Hazard H1 (documented in the PRD): the deployed 0.72.0 `pan`/dashboard reads the now-registered `skills.packs.pstack` without `KNOWN_PACKS.pstack` and shows 0 skills until this merges and `pan reload` runs. Nothing is on, so no launch changes. This is expected.

## Coverage

### Changed-file ledger
| File | Status |
| --- | --- |
| src/lib/skill-packs/adapters.ts | Reviewed: `KnownPack.pluginRoot/ref/mountExtras`, `KNOWN_PACKS.pstack` matches FR-4 exactly, `readPackManifest` reads under `base` and returns repo-relative `dir`/executables via `posix.join(prefix, …)`, `toRepoRelative` rejects empty/absolute/`.`/`..`/`../` (FR-2); with `pluginRoot` unset `prefix=''`, `base=root` → identical output (FR-3). |
| src/lib/skill-packs/sources.ts | Reviewed: `extractCommit` passes `-- <pluginRoot>` to `git archive` after `assertOperand` (no option injection), reuses a cache containing the root, rebuilds a root-less one; add/update/sync all pass `pluginRootOf(id)`; `PackPreview.pluginRoot` set only when defined. Registry entry still has no pluginRoot (non-goal 1). |
| src/lib/skill-packs/mount.ts | Reviewed: extras validated (escape, collision with `skills`/`.claude-plugin`/`.codex-plugin`); copied with `copyWithoutSymlinks` (the `fs.cp` filter also applies to the top-level src, so a symlinked extra is skipped); missing extras skipped; `mountHash` adds extras entries only for packs with extras, so existing hashes are unchanged and `MOUNT_FORMAT_VERSION` stays 2. |
| src/lib/skill-overrides/catalog.ts | Reviewed: passes `pluginRoot` to `readPackManifest` (FR-6). |
| src/lib/skill-overrides/launch.ts | Reviewed: adds `pluginRoot` and `extras` from `KNOWN_PACKS` only when defined (FR-8); skill dirs come from the catalog manifest (repo-relative), joined to `packExtractDir` in the mount. |
| src/cli/commands/skills.ts | Reviewed: url/ref defaults, exact FR-9 error texts, `Root` row only when set (FR-10). Source of the blocking manifest drift. |
| src/**/__tests__/{adapters,sources,mount,launch,skills}.test.ts | Reviewed: 17 new cases; no `.only`/`skipIf`, no source-grep tests; existing cases unchanged. |
| features/skills.mdx, changelog.mdx, .overdeck/context/codebase/architecture.md | Reviewed: FR-11/AC-8 content present (pstack section, opt-in list, `docs/harness/claude-code.md`, `pstack:poteto-agent`, Upcoming v0.73.0 entry, `pluginRoot` in the architecture map). |
| .pan/drafts/PAN-4728.md, PAN-4728-live-checkpoint.md, .pan/continues/…, .pan/specs/… | Planning artifacts, reviewed for requirements; the live checkpoint was cross-checked against host state (below). |

### Dimensions
- Correctness: traced every path (add/update/sync → extract → manifest → catalog → launch → mount). The only defect is the manifest drift.
- Security: `pluginRoot`/`mountExtras` are constants; `git archive` operand guarded and placed after `--`; extras escape/collision checks plus symlink skipping keep pack content inside the mount. No new trust boundary.
- Performance: scoping `git archive` to the subtree reduces blob fetches in the blobless clone. Extras copying is bounded and runs once per mount hash. All I/O stays async (`fs/promises`, `execFile`), so NFR-1 is met.
- Requirements/UX: see the AC matrix. Non-goals hold: no CLI/registry `pluginRoot`, no agents/hooks/MCP/commands mounted, no dashboard or skillsRoot change, and other packs behave as before (their tests pass).

### Acceptance criteria
| AC | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AC-1 (WI-1) | Met | adapters.test.ts `plugin root` cases pass (local run) |
| AC-2 (WI-2) | Met | `KNOWN_PACKS.pstack` toEqual test passes; other entries unchanged in diff |
| AC-3 (WI-3) | Met | sources.test.ts four `plugin root packs` cases pass |
| AC-4 (WI-4) | Met | mount.test.ts extras/hash/rejection cases pass; `MOUNT_FORMAT_VERSION = 2` |
| AC-5 (WI-5) | Met | launch.test.ts pstack mount case passes; catalog passes `pluginRoot` |
| AC-6 (WI-6) | Met | skills.test.ts new `pack add` cases pass; registration shows `add <id> [url]`, `--ref` optional |
| AC-7 (WI-7) | Met | live checkpoint records the 58-skill preview, Root/Not applied rows, 51 skills plus the adapter doc, the invocation reply, and cleanup. `~/.overdeck/config.yaml` shows pstack registered at `ae5650f` with no toggle; projects.yaml has no pstack override |
| AC-8 (WI-8) | Met | docs diff contains every required string |
| AC-9 (all) | **Unmet** | CI `lint-group (core)` fails on `lint:slash-commands` (blocking finding) |

## Verification
- `npx vitest run` on the five touched test files: 5 files, 163 tests passed (local, HEAD 5b382b05).
- `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics`: passed, 227 known findings and none new (local, HEAD 5b382b05).
- CI for head 5b382b05 (run 41339606595): `lint-group (core)` **fail** (manifest drift). Passed: build (22), test-shard 1/4 and 3/4, lint-group skills/state, clean install smoke, prompt-trailer gate, flake lane. Still pending at review time, so unverified: test-shard 2/4 and 4/4, test-e2e, lint-group (effect). `overdeck/test` (local gate: typecheck plus lint subset) passed.
- Full test suite not run (per role policy).
